num_items: <int> Number of items available for selection.
num_objectives: <int> Number of objectives to be simultaneously minimized.
weights: <list[int], length num_items> Weight of each item.
capacity: <int> Maximum total weight the knapsack can hold.
objective_coefficients: <list[list[int]], shape [num_objectives][num_items]> Contribution of each item to each objective when selected.
